question: What is gen1's datum at Elba, on the delivered surface and on ours, with every choice that moves it declared?

inputs.role: catchment-free per-line datum; marks assigned by their own ground returns, reused psids disambiguated by track collinearity
per-mark bridge on open ground; its population mean carries a delivered-surface constant onto ours

params.name: adopted_collinear_sigma
params.why: the estimate is flat across sigma 2-3 (0.47 mm) and jumps 8.22 mm at sigma 5 where the disambiguation readmits marks on non-collinear passes; 3 sits at the top of the stable range

params.name: catchment_radius_m
params.why: removed: it was a compute bound, not a criterion, and it admitted marks the pass test rejects

params.name: cover
params.why: NOT yet narrowed to open-only; doing so is an open decision that will move this number

params.name: gen2_side
params.why: gen2's bridge is not measurable at its checkpoints (engineered siting), so a DoD correction built from these two constants is asymmetric

columns.value_mm: millimetres; positive = the surface reads LOW, so ADD it
columns.uncert_of: what that uncertainty is the uncertainty OF

headline: gen1 at Elba: delivered +45.57 +/- 18.81; our surface +41.53 +/- 21.85 mm
